task: Add a backend endpoint that packages a user's authorized Agent Workspace files into a single zip archive preserving folder structure (EPMCDME-15770).

key_reasoning.reason: Closest pattern is download_workspace_file plus get_workspace_input_files, but neither covers multi-blob archive assembly. It is the first multi-blob read in one request, with unbounded in-memory buffering and no size or count cap. Byte fidelity (AC4) differs by backend: GCP decodes text with backslashreplace and the filesystem repo reads text/* in text mode. Zip entry names need re-validation against workspace_path_rules (traversal, reserved names). _as_http_error returns str(exception) on 500, which risks leaking blob details (AC8). AC10 enumerates edge cases (nested, empty, failure, authorization) and no router test harness exists for agent_workspace.py. Scored L rather than M for the security-surface divergence and the missing router-test template; not XL because the pattern is otherwise in-repo and the change is reversible and additive.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk raised from M to L: security-sensitive aspects (zip entry-name safety, error-detail leakage, per-user authorization boundary) are not covered by the closest existing pattern, and enumerated edge-case ACs have no router-level test template.
Requirements Clarity held at M (not bumped further): audit logging meaning and the progress state (AC6) are open, but the core ACs are defined.
